g.text: Tell me how to easily beat charmander
Assuming you mean the Pokémon Charmander (a pure Fire type), the easiest approach is to hit it with
Squirtle, Wartortle, Blastoise, Psyduck, Lapras, or any Water move like Water Gun, Surf, or Bubble.
Sandshrew, Diglett, Geodude, Onix, or moves like Earthquake and Mud-Slap.
Geodude, Onix, or Rock Throw and Rock Slide.
Avoid sending in Grass, Ice, Bug, or Steel types, since Fire hits them hard. Fire and Dragon types take little damage from Charmander's Ember.
If you meant a different game or a different Charmander (for example in Smash Bros or Pokken), tell me which and I'll adjust.
